groups.defect: EventManager dereferences mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration when the destination calendar array is empty or nullish, causing Google Meet location processing to throw.
groups.rationale: All five report the same missing optional chain at the same access. Their references to producer sites explain how the undefined value arises; one guard resolves every report.

groups.defect: Google Calendar updateEvent and deleteEvent search destination calendars using an already-falsy externalCalendarId, losing the configured destination calendar fallback.
groups.rationale: The identical faulty fallback appears in both methods and requires an edit in each. Two suggestions explicitly report both occurrences, linking the update-only and delete-only reports.

groups.defect: EventManager drops result.credentialId from non-calendar booking references, preventing consumers from identifying the video credential.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same conditional assignment that replaces the video credential ID with undefined. The cancellation failure is a downstream consequence of that same defect.

groups.defect: Collective team destination calendars are discarded because the optional push does nothing when the organizer and event type have no destination calendar.
groups.rationale: All three report the same null initialization followed by an optional push. Initializing or assigning the merged array resolves all three.
